pkgmetadata.longdescription:
camofox runs the Camoufox anti-detection browser (a Firefox fork with fingerprint spoofing) behind a local HTTP control API, so an agent can drive real pages without a detection stack noticing an automated browser. The `camofox` CLI wraps that API for shell use.
This localrepo package ships a prepared runtime bundle of @askjo/camofox-browser plus its production node_modules, installed to the same path a global npm install uses. ::gentoo has no npm eclass, so a source ebuild would have to resolve the dependency tree from the network on every merge; the pinned bundle hash gives the same reproducibility without that.
The Camoufox browser binary itself is a version-pinned runtime download cached under ~/.cache/camoufox (about 1.3 GB). It is treated as a cache rather than a packaged artifact because upstream bumps it frequently and camoufox-js pins the expected build in-process.
